program_name: Crystal International Group — Crystal Associate Programme

levels.chua_dat: Below the program's academic standard (A soon-to-graduate student or someone with less than 2 years of full-time work experience, with a minimum GPA of 7.0/10 or equivalent (graduating with a Good classification or higher)) or the CV does not clearly state GPA/major.
levels.dat: A soon-to-graduate student or someone with less than 2 years of full-time work experience, with a minimum GPA of 7.0/10 or equivalent (graduating with a Good classification or higher)
levels.noi_bat: GPA ~8.5/10 (3.5/4.0) or above, scholarship or top departmental ranking; major closely matches the applied track, or holds a double degree/supplementary professional certificate.

levels.chua_dat: CV shows no evidence of English proficiency (certificate, English-medium program, English-speaking work environment). Program standard: Good communication skills and English proficiency sufficient for daily work
levels.dat: Good communication skills and English proficiency sufficient for daily work
levels.noi_bat: IELTS 7.0+/TOEIC 900+ or has studied/worked entirely in English; confident presenting, debating cases, and interviewing on a panel in English.

levels.chua_dat: No leadership role shown: only a club member, or the CV shows no meaningful extracurricular activity.
levels.dat: And above all, you are passionate about the garment and fashion industry, aspire to become a future leader, and are willing to work in Hải Phòng/ Bắc Ninh/ Nghệ An and Hà Nội.
levels.noi_bat: Club president / lead organizer of a large-scale event / project founder — with measurable results (team size led, budget scale, growth achieved).

levels.chua_dat: No internship/work experience relevant to: Has at least one internship/project relevant to the function applied for at Crystal International Group , with a clear description of the actual work done (not just the title).
levels.dat: Has at least one internship/project relevant to the function applied for at Crystal International Group , with a clear description of the actual work done (not just the title).
levels.noi_bat: Two or more relevant internships, or one internship with a measurable achievement (KPI hit, project actually shipped) at a company in the same industry as Crystal International Group .

levels.chua_dat: No evidence of analytical thinking: no quantitative coursework, data project, or case-practice experience.
levels.dat: Has an analytical foundation (quantitative coursework, strong Excel, prior case practice) — enough to pass the program's assessment/aptitude test.
levels.noi_bat: Case competition achievements or a real analytical project + solid tools (advanced Excel, SQL/Python if the track needs it) — ready for both aptitude tests and assessment centres.

levels.chua_dat: CV does not mention any award, scholarship, or competition.
levels.dat: Has taken part in an academic/case competition or won a school-level scholarship/award.
levels.noi_bat: Reached the final rounds or won a major competition (case competitions in the relevant industry, national hackathon/datathon) or a national-level scholarship/award.

criteria.label_en: Crystal International Group  culture & motivation fit

levels.chua_dat: CV shows no genuine interest signal or motivation tied to Crystal International Group  or its industry; generic application reasons only.
levels.dat: Shows genuine motivation for the industry/function and a mindset aligned with Crystal International Group 's stated values.
levels.noi_bat: A clear, specific story connecting personal motivation, prior projects, and understanding of Crystal International Group 's business/brand/values in Vietnam.

ideal_profile_text:
A soon-to-graduate student or someone with less than 2 years of full-time work experience
Minimum GPA of 7.0/10 or equivalent (graduating with a Good classification or higher)
Good communication skills and English proficiency sufficient for daily work 
And above all, you are passionate about the garment and fashion industry, aspire to become a future leader, and are willing to work in Hải Phòng/ Bắc Ninh/ Nghệ An and Hà Nội.
